import urllib.request, json

p = "/opt/trading-bot/swings_web.py"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
old = 'DBS = {"new": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall5.db", "old": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall4.db", "older": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall3_before_reset_20261010.db"}'

s = s.replace(old, 'DBS = {"new": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall6.db", "old": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall5.db", "older": "/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall4.db"}')

PY

sleep 100

journalctl -u wallbot --since "-2min" --no-pager | grep -v "Started\|Stopped\|Consumed\|Stopping" | tail -4
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, sqlite3
d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api"))
c = d["cfg"]
print("FEE", c["FEE"], "стоп: STOP_FROM_ENTRY_BPS", c["STOP_FROM_ENTRY_BPS"], "под стенкой", c["STOP_UNDER_WALL_BPS"], c["STOP_REF"], "| безубыток", c["BE_TRIGGER_BPS"], "+", c["BE_SLIP_BPS"], "| пар", len(d["syms"]))
db = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall6.db?mode=ro", uri=True)

print("в /stats: безубыток поз.", "безубыток поз." in html, "| страница 18093:", len(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8093/?db=new").read()), "байт")
